title: Outside-Shop Repair Reimbursement Terms, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Terms.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, an outside-shop repair is reimbursed only when it was authorized as an outside-shop remedy before the work was done, where the plan requires outside-shop repairs to be authorized before the work. The paid invoice is submitted no later than the plan's invoice window days after the outside repair. Days are calendar days counted from the invoice date as day zero; an invoice submitted on the last day is in time. The amount approved is the lesser of the paid invoice and the plan's reimbursement cap, and it is paid by check or ACH within the plan's reimbursement payment business days, once per approval. Work beyond the covered concern on the same invoice is not reimbursed.

## Invoice window

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The outside repair, dated by the invoice date |
| Whose word governs the invoice date | The customer's statement of the outside repair's invoice date, for the coverage concerned |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Day zero | The invoice date |
| Boundary | An invoice submitted on the last day is in time |

Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-day window): invoice dated 10 April. Day zero is 10 April and the last day is 10 May. Submitted on 10 May, the invoice is in time; submitted on 11 May, it is later than the window.

## Amount approved

The amount approved is the lesser of the paid invoice and the plan's reimbursement cap, for the covered concern only.

| Hypothetical paid invoice for the covered concern | Hypothetical cap | Amount approved |
|---|---|---|
| USD 420.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 350.00, the cap being the lesser |
| USD 280.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 280.00, the invoice being the lesser |
| USD 350.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 350.00 |

Where the same invoice also carries work beyond the covered concern, that work is not reimbursed.

## Payment

An approved reimbursement is paid to the customer by check or ACH within the plan's reimbursement payment business days, once per approval. The approval records the outside shop as named on its invoice, the invoice amount, the invoice date, the concern and the remedy attempt reimbursed.
